# ===============================
#   MAIN FUNCTION

make_species_plots <- function(yvar, y_label = yvar, y_limits = c(0, 150)) {
  
  # dynamic column reference
  ycol <- rlang::sym(yvar)
  
  make_one_plot <- function(species_name) {
    
    df <- data[data$name == species_name, ]
  
    # mean of control
    mean_control <- mean(df[df$Sub == "C", ][[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    ggplot(df, aes(x = Sub, y = !!ycol, colour = Sub)) +
      
      geom_boxplot(aes(group = Sub),
                   colour = "black",
                   fill = "grey90",
                   alpha = 0.5) +
      
      geom_hline(yintercept = mean_control,
                 colour = "black",
                 linetype = "dotted",
                 linewidth = 1) +
      
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +
      
      annotate("label",
               x = 4, y = y_limits[2] - 1,
               label = "test",#HELP
               fill = "white",
               colour = "black",
               size = 3) +
      
      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
      
      labs(title = bquote(italic(.(species_name))),
           x = "",
           y = y_label) +
      
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
      }
  
  # Build 6 plots
  p_list <- lapply(species_order, make_one_plot)
  
  final_plot <- ((p_list[[1]] | p_list[[2]] | p_list[[3]]) /
                   (p_list[[4]] | p_list[[5]] | p_list[[6]])) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
#ggsave(filename= paste0("species_boxplots_", y_label,".png"),
#       plot = final_plot,
#       width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 300)

  return(final_plot)
}

The graphic for C13/o18 are created in python. # ANOVA

#global ANOVA for all the samples
#variables = δ18O in ‰ vs DeltaSMOW`
  
anova_species_treat <- aov( `iWUE (μmol/mol)`~ name * Sub, data = data) #Uses all dataset. Interaction between species and treatment
summary(anova_species_treat)
##              Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)    
## name          2  87606   43803 212.042 <2e-16 ***
## Sub           3    166      55   0.267  0.849    
## name:Sub      6    903     151   0.729  0.627    
## Residuals   117  24169     207                   
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 51 observations deleted due to missingness

The interaction is only relevant for one species. The Pouteris and Myrcia N15.

Funcion tabla

tabla <- function(model_list) {

  tab <- modelsummary(
    model_list,
    output = "data.frame",
    statistics = TRUE,
    stars = TRUE,
    gof_map = c("nobs", "r2.marginal", "r2.conditional", "aic")
  )

  # Transponer
  tab_t <- as.data.frame(t(tab))

  # Usar primera fila como nombres
  colnames(tab_t) <- as.character(tab_t[1, ])

  # Hacer nombres únicos 
  colnames(tab_t) <- make.unique(colnames(tab_t))

  # Eliminar fila usada como header
  tab_t <- tab_t[-1, , drop = FALSE]

  # Guardar nombres de modelo
  tab_t$Modelo <- rownames(tab_t)
  rownames(tab_t) <- NULL

  # Reordenar columnas
  tab_t <- tab_t[, c("Modelo", setdiff(names(tab_t), "Modelo")), drop = FALSE]

  # Exportar a Excel
  write.xlsx(tab_t, "model_list.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE, asTable = TRUE)

  message("✔ Model saved on excel")

  # Retornar tabla para markdown / PDF / HTML
  return(kbl(tab_t, booktabs = TRUE, align = "l"))
}

Funcion para graficar

tabla <- function(lista_modelos) {

  for(nombre in names(lista_modelos)){

    model_list <- lista_modelos[[nombre]]

    tab <- modelsummary(
      model_list,
      output = "data.frame",
      statistics = TRUE,
      stars = TRUE,
      gof_map = c("nobs", "r2.marginal", "r2.conditional", "aic")
    )

    # Transponer
    tab_t <- as.data.frame(t(tab))

    # Usar primera fila como nombres
    colnames(tab_t) <- as.character(tab_t[1, ])
    colnames(tab_t) <- make.unique(colnames(tab_t))

    # Eliminar header
    tab_t <- tab_t[-1, , drop = FALSE]

    # Guardar nombres de modelo
    tab_t$Modelo <- rownames(tab_t)
    rownames(tab_t) <- NULL

    # Reordenar columnas
    tab_t <- tab_t[, c("Modelo", setdiff(names(tab_t), "Modelo")), drop = FALSE]

    # Exportar Excel
    archivo <- paste0("modelos_", nombre, ".xlsx")
    write.xlsx(tab_t, archivo, overwrite = TRUE, asTable = TRUE)

    message(paste("✔ Excel creado:", archivo))
  }

}

library(broom.mixed)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

plot_coefs <- function(model, title, control = "C") {

  coefs <- tidy(
    model,
    effects = "fixed",
    conf.int = TRUE,
    conf.level = 0.95
  ) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      term = gsub("^Sub", "", term),
      sig = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE            ~ ""
      )
    )

  # 👉 Agregar explícitamente el control
  control_row <- tibble(
    term = control,
    estimate = 0,
    conf.low = 0,
    conf.high = 0,
    sig = ""
  )

  coefs <- bind_rows(control_row, coefs)

  ggplot(coefs, aes(x = term, y = estimate)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, color = "blue") +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      width = 0.15
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = sig, y = conf.high),
      vjust = -0.6,
      size = 5
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "",
      y = "Estimate (± 95% CI)"
    ) +
   scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2)))+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
}

    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      term = gsub("^Sub", "", term),
      sig = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE            ~ ""
      )
    )

  # 👉 Agregar explícitamente el control
  control_row <- tibble(
    term = control,
    estimate = 0,
    conf.low = 0,
    conf.high = 0,
    sig = ""
  )

  coefs <- bind_rows(control_row, coefs)

  ggplot(coefs, aes(x = term, y = estimate)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, color = "blue") +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      width = 0.15
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = sig, y = conf.high),
      vjust = -0.6,
      size = 5
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "",
      y = "Estimate (± 95% CI)"
    ) +
   scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2)))+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
}

plot_diagnostics <- function(model, model_name) {
  
  res <- residuals(model)#residual
  fit <- fitted(model) #model
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2)) #graph
  
  # Residuals vs Fitted
  plot(fit, res,
       xlab = "Fitted values",
       ylab = "Residuals",
       main = paste(model_name, "\nResiduals vs Fitted"))
  abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
  
  # QQ plot
  qqnorm(res, main = paste(model_name, "\nNormal Q-Q"))
  qqline(res, col = "red", lty = 2)
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}

#apply the plot_diagnostics_to_all
pdf("model_diagnostics_species_dummies.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)

for (nm in names(models_iWUE_d)) {
  plot_diagnostics(models_iWUE_d[[nm]], nm)
}
